description: This is a fun deck that I play in some fun classics. The players I play with use classic rules but with one exception NO (V) cards I know I know I thought that it was BS when I heard it, but it is really fun and is a challenge!
strategy:
peeps dont see that one of the rules for the guys i play with is that it is classic format and no (V) cards!

edit: 1x lightsaber prof., Anis saber, and  staging areas(couldnt acquire one) out

1x revolution in , 2x OOC and trans terminated in

Strategy

Well staging areas gives you a little extra activation while you try to get ur Twix sites out. After that you can pull honor of the Jedi if you didn’t get it.

There are two things to this deck: A butload of activation… and a few broken cards. This is all about using the cards tech! With this deck there are so many destiny adders that I decided I needed to add some cards that will slow your opponent down right after he draws... this is oola and leesub. Get them together and they are pretty useful. Basically what I do is try to deploy them to some site that is out of the way with either a houjix, or rebel barrier in hand. You reveal their hand and boot out their male characters and then you have a good idea of what is left in their hand to make an educated guess with leesub! This deck I designed to be a basic bag of tricks.

You have a few drain modifiers Ani’s stick and the lightsaber proficiencies which BTW turn ur epps into tanks. Also use traffic control to recycle your cards and bolster your wins.

This deck is pretty straight forward steal their sites, use ur tech cards, and LEAVE NO ONE ALIVE!!!
